mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can impair renal function; indomethacin reduces renal perfusion via prostaglandin inhibition while zoledronic acid is directly nephrotoxic, increasing risk of acute kidney injury and bisphosphonate-related complications.
action: Monitor renal function closely (eGFR, creatinine) before and during concurrent use; consider alternative NSAIDs or pain management; ensure adequate hydration; avoid in patients with pre-existing renal impairment.
